mainEntity.name: What factors influence the overall cost of a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost of a garage conversion depends on the intended function and structural scope of the room. A basic dry room conversion—such as a home office, gym, or playroom—primarily involves framing, insulation, drywall, flooring, lighting, and HVAC adjustments. Costs increase significantly if you intend to create a self-contained in-law suite or accessory dwelling unit requiring rough-in plumbing, waste lines cut into the concrete slab, full bathroom fixtures, or kitchen cabinetry. Finish selections, electrical panel capacity, and the method used to close off the garage door opening also dictate final project estimates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on whether you need plumbing for a bathroom or kitchenette, electrical panel upgrades, HVAC installation, and the level of interior finishes selected.
